title: Compose execution budgets across ZIP, CFB and source-backed read sessions
decision: retained and implemented for the three explicit read-session boundaries
code_state: IoConcurrency is additive in litchi-core; ZIP OpenSession and ParallelReadSession, CFB SharedOleBulkRead, and source-backed ordered Part reads compose Workers, IoConcurrency, CpuTasks and caller facilities
authority: accepted ADR 0031, change 0652 decision 6, landed 0662 prerequisite

accepted_evidence.api_compatibility: Limits::new keeps six arguments; the existing two-argument with_execution remains available and with_execution_io opts into the third dimension
accepted_evidence.lazy_pool: ZIP and CFB private pools are absent at session construction and appear only after an eligible batch is admitted
accepted_evidence.composition: shared-root tests retain private-pool worker permits, narrow a second session deterministically, pass the admitted width into each task wave including cached pools, and release permits at session drop
accepted_evidence.io_admission: ZIP, CFB and source-backed tests refuse zero IoConcurrency before payload read and release serial permits after failure
accepted_evidence.caller_facility: ZIP, CFB and source-backed ordered-read tests route borrowed tasks through a caller facility without constructing a private pool
accepted_evidence.correctness: ordered results remain byte-identical to serial results, active CFB reads stay within a narrowed cached-pool width, and source-backed errors retain typed failure behavior
accepted_evidence.cpu_admission: ZIP and source-backed reads charge CpuTasks after deterministic preflight/output admission and worker/I/O admission; CFB charges per admitted batch, so refusal paths before payload work consume no CPU units

accepted_costs.admission: each explicit read operation pays hierarchical reservation checks for worker and positional-read permits
accepted_costs.retained_pool: a private pool keeps its admitted Workers reservation until its session is dropped
accepted_costs.api_surface: a ninth Resource dimension and an additive execution builder are public low-level budget API changes

known_gaps.measurement: no latency, throughput, scaling or cross-platform scheduler measurement was run
known_gaps.thread_probe: this packet does not claim a /proc/self/task process-wide thread-count capture
known_gaps.ordinary_api: ordinary package CRUD and constructors remain outside explicit execution sessions
known_gaps.finite_profiles: the named profiles use finite Workers, IoConcurrency and CpuTasks values; workload-specific limits remain caller-selected

withheld: any claim that ordinary serial CRUD gained parallelism
any claim of a cross-platform latency or throughput improvement

provenance.validation: targeted fmt, full four-crate tests (1,877 passed, 2 ignored), clippy and docs with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 and target /tmp/litchi-0676-debug0
